failed_witness: The first isolated Python dependency audit returned seven advisory records against the virtual-environment bootstrap pip distribution, so the transaction remained quarantined and all thirteen direct additions retained zero installation credit.
passing_witness: The direct-tool functional smoke matrix had passed, Node reported zero audit findings, and every direct Python pin remained exact; those bounded witnesses did not override the dependency audit.
recovery: Install the exact current compatible pip wheel from the official registry into the same isolated environment, verify its published SHA-256, and rerun only the failed Python dependency-audit component.
recurrence_guard: Audit the environment bootstrap distributions as well as direct tool pins before assigning completed installation credit.
rollback: The original audit receipt and quarantined catalog remain immutable; the additive correction can be discarded without changing the source or sibling lanes.
sibling_recommendation: Keep functional smoke credit separate from dependency-audit credit and preserve every original advisory result.
